name: DCA Adorable Snowman Frosted Treats Pixar Pier Frosty Parfait (Lemon Soft-Serve — CRITICAL Citrus Warning!)
brandOrRestaurant: Adorable Snowman Frosted Treats (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Reference warning: while "It's Lemon!" soft-serve and the blue-raspberry Pixar Pier Frosty Parfait are famous for being dairy-free, they are made with concentrated tart lemon juice—making them a direct hit against your citrus guardrail.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Do NOT order "It's Lemon!" or the Pixar Pier Frosty Parfait; order the Chocolate or Vanilla soft-serve cup at the same window instead.
watchOuts: CRITICAL CITRUS TRIGGER: Made with tart lemon soft-serve (citrusFree: false)
